meta.title: Pet Simulator 99 shiny relics data

sources.label: Pet Simulator Wiki - Shiny Relic (Pet Simulator 99)

meta.approvedScope: Permanent Shiny Relic collectible locations in Pet Simulator 99, grouped by Trading Plaza and world route. Temporary event collectibles, badges, gamepasses, developer products, platform metadata, current raids, and broad update summaries are excluded.

sourceAudit.imagePlan: Images intentionally left empty until clean row-specific relic/location screenshots can be gathered locally.
notes: Rows were parsed from the current Pet Simulator Wiki Shiny Relic table through the Fandom API.
The visible title may use 200 because the source count and final local dataset both have exactly 200 permanent relic rows.
Every item uses the approved minimal player-facing card fields: World, Area, Location hint, Space, and Progress note.
No row images are wired because clean local row-specific screenshots were not gathered in this Phase 2 pass.
